capacity.limitations: Design carrying capacity, including seats and standing places. The report does not establish the actual consist, delivered train frequency, occupancy or throughput for any future departure.

nominal_train_capacity.limitations: Design carrying capacity, including seats and standing places. The report does not establish the actual consist, delivered train frequency, occupancy or throughput for any future departure.

definitions.terminal_departure: Count each journey's first-stop departure only. Exact schedules use a departure event. Frequency intervals contribute overlap seconds divided by headway seconds. Both directions add two terminal streams for the same route, without cross-route sums.
definitions.schedule_lifespan: Future activity uses a fixed reference schedule. The archive contains no GTFS calendar_dates table. Dates flagged by the archived holiday calendar or without a covered holiday calendar have no paired dated supply.
definitions.intensity: Ratio of forecast published trips to reference two-direction departures on the same set of included days. Historical weekday-matched baseline uses the same denominator.
definitions.nominal_supply: Terminal departures times editable nominal design places per three-car train. Estimates depend on train formation and reference service being delivered.
definitions.peak_proxy: Saved Komuter hourly shares multiply daily OD scenarios. Network and Port Klang West, pooled and each observed year, are separate sensitivities. Each day retains all 24 bins. Peak windows sum the two matching hourly demand and supply values.
definitions.coverage: Station-origin demand has no directional or segment distribution. Supply remains separate from demand in the peak export. No occupancy or pressure ratio is calculated.
